selection_status: Rules fixed before first performance calculation; no parameter search
capital_interpretation: Each symbol is a separate alternative $2000 account simulation, never added together
reserved: No 2026 performance calculation in this experiment; independent forward collection still required
data_inspection_disclosure: Five hourly bars per symbol on 2025-01-01 were inspected for API response structure before this design; 2025 is not represented as a fully blinded test

strategy.entry: close exceeds previous 20 completed highs, and compression occurred within previous 6 completed bars
strategy.exit: close crosses entry-price-minus-2ATR, previous 10-bar low, or maximum holding time; exit at a later open

cost_disclosure: Current Alpaca tier-1 taker fee used as a forward-cost assumption on historical prices, not asserted as the historical fee schedule. Slippage and $10/month overhead are assumed. Fees modeled in credited assets. No fee-tier optimization.
primary_metric: One-calendar-year net return together with observed marked-equity drawdown
rejection_rules: If both chronological windows lose after assumed costs, do not advance this frozen baseline to paper trading.
If only gross performance is positive, treat cost sensitivity as a mechanism failure for this route.
A 40% observed drawdown breach fails the risk condition; never clip losses to the threshold.
Even profitable bars cannot certify executable returns without quotes, sizes, receipt times and permission checks.
baseline_status: Price-proxy falsification screen; not an execution replay or deployment approval
